prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object is approached, take it, move to storage, check properties, and perform task; or avoid obstacle or move to object. list of available nodes: <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <Action ID = MoveToStorage    /> <SubTree ID = CheckObjectProperties    /> <Action ID = PerformTask    /> <Condition ID = IsObstacleInFront    /> <Action ID = AvoidObstacle    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Sequence>     <Action ID = TakeObject    />     <Action ID = MoveToStorage    />     <SubTree ID = CheckObjectProperties    />     <Action ID = PerformTask    /> </Sequence> <Action ID = ScanArea    /> <Sequence>     <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    />     <Action ID = MoveToObject    /> </Sequence> <Sequence>     <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    />     <Action ID = TakeObject    />     <SubTree ID = CheckObjectProperties    />     <Action ID = PerformTask    /> </Sequence>"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO TakeObject
	ELSE
		DO MoveToStorage
		DO CheckObjectProperties
		DO PerformTask
	END
